title.narrative: Strengthening Institutional Capacity for Monitoring and Evaluation of Agricultural Policy Instruments - IDF

description.narrative: " Following the successful implementation of the Bank's Policy Note ""Belarus - Agricultural Productivity and Competitiveness, Impact of State Support and Market Intervention"", the government of Belarus has requested additional and more comprehensive assistance from the World Bank for the design and partial funding of a program to enhance domestic capacity for the monitoring and evaluation of agricultural policy instruments, recognizing that the country possesses insufficient capacity to undertake relevant policy impact analyses without which the government is not prepared to undertake serious reform steps. Such a program would intend to enhance the government's capacity to design and execute policies and reform programs in the agricultural sector and to support agricultural development overall. The government wishes to design this program as an institutional development program rather than providing individual training events, and wishes to cover the following elements: (i) Establishment of enhanced indicators by which sector performance will be evaluated in the future; (ii) Identification of appropriate methodologies for the calculation of such indictors; (iii) Institutional capacity development (through capacity gap analysis and targeted, specific enhancement program) of relevant institutions in Belarus; (iv) Formulation of options for policy instruments based on the country's socio-economic objectives; (v) Impact analysis for these options (as on-the-job training for newly built capacities); (vi) Review of the existing institutional system for agricultural policy implementation and assessment of the need to enhance a public administration and control system for agricultural policy implementation and monitoring. The program would also be expected to support the intensification of relevant international partnerships. TF098649 The objective of the proposed activities is to strengthen the Government of Belarus' (GoB) capacity to monitor, design and implement policies and reform programs in the agricultural sector to enhance the quality, acceptability and sustainability of domestic agricultural policy. The IDF grant will promote the establishment of an agricultural policy analysis unit and introduce internationally accepted monitoring and evaluation methodologies to increase the transparency and efficiency of domestic agricultural support measures in Belarus."
